# Facilitator-only material

Applies only to reference outcomes, the answer key, issue manifest, and progressive hints. Keep participant-facing docs spoiler-free and label facilitator content clearly. Record expected discovery rather than asserting real-world policy. Do not add confidential data. Review consistency against code and traceability; validate referenced files and IDs before changing the manifest.
